recommendations: Include explicit operand records with ID, value, row, column, section, years, dimension, scale and currency alongside the original table.
Fix bounded aggregation year ranges and constrained prior-period comparison for a single-year temporal change while preserving wrong-period rejection.
Resolve the main requested operation before metric qualifiers; support explicit sums and common-size averages without forcing every total or percentage phrase into one operator.
Recognize explicit currency shorthand and count multipliers. Type count synonyms and common-size percentage declarations conservatively.
Extend typed arithmetic only where units justify it: count times price and amount divided by a percentage fraction. Preserve currency and dimension compatibility.
Keep duplicate-source, wrong-year and unit rejection: these catch actual model errors. Clarify ambiguous repeated row labels.
Freeze the new policy using development only, then conduct a predeclared source-group-disjoint evaluation. Preserve historical reports, scoring, confidence intervals and coverage.
limitations: The 100 training-development contexts have already been inspected; these results do not estimate generalization.
Primary categories are engineering judgments; some examples have multiple causes.
Alternative source-grounded interpretations are documented without altering historical scoring.
No prediction code, weights, protocols, source data, or existing reports were modified.
